card.name: Words leading into intoxication or substance misuse
card.fires_on: The word "other" in "concomitant use of other medications, alcohol..." in benzodiazepine abuse and misuse warnings. It also fires on words like "getting" or "include" just before drunkenness or overdose symptoms.

modes.label: Concomitant use of other
modes.description: The word "other" after "concomitant use of" in benzodiazepine abuse and misuse warnings, just before a list of alcohol and substances.
modes.example: benzodiazepines often (but not always) involve the use of doses greater than the maximum recommended dosage and commonly involve concomitant use of<< other>> medications, alcohol, and/or illicit substances

modes.label: Drunkenness or overdose lead-in
modes.description: A verb right before words for being drunk or for overdose effects.
modes.example: 14-027977-6 - "Modern Drunkard" magazine - a humorous magazine about drink and the art of<< getting>> drunk - Famous Drinking Quotes - a

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for being intoxicated, drunk or hallucinating.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name intoxication or the effects of drugs and alcohol.
